label: Real Business Problems
heading: Har business ki apni problem hoti hai.
description: Sometimes customers come in, but enquiries aren't managed. Sometimes bookings happen, but tracking is difficult. Sometimes there's a website, but it doesn't actually benefit the business.

items.title: Lost Enquiries
items.body: Customers reach out through WhatsApp, Instagram, and calls, but important enquiries easily get missed.

items.title: Manual Work
items.body: Bookings, customer details, orders, and follow-ups are still managed on notebooks, Excel, or WhatsApp.

items.title: Repeated Questions
items.body: Customers repeatedly ask the same information: price, services, timings, location, availability, etc.

items.title: Website That Doesn't Help
items.body: The website is online, but customers don't get a clear next step.

items.title: Scattered Information
items.body: Business information is scattered across different apps and places.

items.title: Follow-up Problems
items.body: Following up with an interested customer later on gets missed.
